target.title: improve(matrix): generate executable QA route and state evidence
target.body:
Closes #100038
Related: #99707

## What Problem This Solves

Matrix QA scenarios exercised real Tuwunel client/server behavior but did not produce a redacted, executable description of the ordered route and state contract observed during each run. Maintainers had to interpret logs manually to diagnose drift across retries, errors, sync tokens, devices, keys, media, and room-key backups.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change places Tuwunel traffic behind a bounded redacting request/response recorder and derives the versioned `matrix-qa-v1` manifest from completed scenario traffic. It adds a substrate-neutral Matrix protocol probe plus independently callable Matrix runtime, harness, recorder, and probe functions, without adding a second adapter registry/host or importing QA Lab private modules.

The Matrix protocol fixture proves the generic probe contract in this PR. #99707 owns canonical `QaTransportAdapterFactory` construction, the shared host, and real Crabline target execution.

This PR was developed with AI assistance. No agent transcript is included.

## User Impact

Matrix QA maintainers can inspect per-scenario ordered routes, redacted request/response shapes, adjacent retry and terminal error sequences, principal-scoped sync-token progression, and device/key/media/backup expectations. Probe mismatches remain visible as failed checks while partial route/state evidence is still written. There is no change to the user-facing Matrix plugin runtime.

## Evidence

- Focused runtime and recorder proof: 2 files, 38 tests passed.
- Full Matrix extension proof: 24 files, 233 tests passed with one worker.
- Fresh structured autoreview on head `dc974b08083678577d46dccc165561e448f986b3`: no accepted/actionable findings (thread `019f2e5c-9342-7d33-b435-3f08b4b7c766`).
- Exact-content `check:changed` passed on Blacksmith Testbox-through-Crabbox: `tbx_01kwq5x3md445ggxskawa3w04k`, Actions run `28715487999`.
- Dependency Guard concern resolved by removing the direct `@openclaw/crabline` dependency and lockfile changes; the final diff adds no dependency surface.
- Live Tuwunel profile collection completed for fast, transport, media, E2EE smoke, E2EE deep, and E2EE CLI profiles. Generated manifests validated for all specialized profiles.
- Existing scenario timeouts remained in three tool-progress transport scenarios and two generated-media/voice-preflight scenarios; all E2EE profiles passed completely.
